questionText:
A European industrial supply firm assesses the cost-volume-profit parameters for a precision valve component:

- Annual Fixed Manufacturing Overhead: €84,000
- Unit Selling Price: €160
- Direct Variable Cost per Unit: €90

What is the minimum annual unit sales volume required to break even?

academicData.title: Economics & Financial Analysis Experimental Matrix
academicData.caption: Table: Observed measurements, empirical data, and benchmark outcomes.
